en-US.shortDescription: Explore pediatric clinical tools and deterministic calculations through Alexa+.
en-US.fullDescription: PedsCore AI is an educational pediatric clinical learning add-on built on the open-source PedsCore project. It helps users discover structured pediatric scores and reference tools, inspect required inputs and evidence metadata, and execute supported calculations through deterministic PedsCore logic. The conversational layer orchestrates tool selection and interaction; clinical calculations are performed by application code rather than generated by a language model. The experience is intended for education, training, simulation, and clinical reference. It is not a substitute for professional medical judgment, local protocols, or direct patient assessment. Users should not submit identifiable patient information.
examplePhrases: Find a pediatric score for assessing croup severity
Show me the inputs needed for the Apgar score
Calculate an Apgar score from these findings
